title: Sphinx enclosure opening said to connect to the Queen's Chamber

tellings.quote: For example, there are three openings on the back of the Sphinx enclosure. One of which has been corroborated by a friend of mine in the Egyptian Ministry of Antiquities to connect into the Queen's Chamber of the Great Pyramid

plain: There are three openings at the back of the walled area around the Sphinx in Giza, Egypt, and one of them connects into the Queen's Chamber, a room inside the Great Pyramid. So says Geoffrey Drumm, a guest who offers his own theory of what the pyramids were for. He says an unnamed friend in Egypt's Ministry of Antiquities, the government office that runs its ancient sites, confirmed it to him. If so, it would mean hidden passages link the Sphinx and the pyramid.
